top_signals.title: New Chief of Staff, Chain Reaction Tech Selloff
top_signals.summary: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Yorkville Ives & Co. Partner & Senior Managing Director Dan Ives, Rutgers-Eagleton Center for Public Interest Polling Director Ashley Koning, PNC Asset Management Group Chief Investment Officer Amanda Agati, Travel Journalist Brittany Chang, Atlanta Journal-Constitution Washington Bureau Chief Tia Mitchell, ​​General Catalyst Chairman & Managing Director Ken Chenault and Composer & Pianist Missy Mazzoli. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
